name: Parker Medical Associates, LLC
old_description: For almost 40 years, Parker Medical Associates, LLC has been a premier manufacturer of specialty athletic protective guards and other resin impregnated fiberglass-based products located in Charlotte, NC.
about:
Parker Medical Associates, LLC operates from Charlotte, North Carolina, where it was founded in 1987 by Bruce Parker. Parker began manufacturing a patented fiberglass roll splinting system that transformed fracture care worldwide. The company remains privately owned under Parker’s leadership.

Today the firm focuses on specialty athletic protective guards and resin‑impregnated fiberglass products, serving as the official manufacturer of the EvoShield® GEL‑TO‑SHELL™ line for Wilson Sporting Goods. Its Charlotte facility provides full‑service cut‑and‑sew operations including sewing, contract cutting, specialty knitting, and packaging and fulfillment. The company also produces signature cut‑and‑sew product lines for a range of other customers.

Primary markets include sporting goods, medical devices, and textile manufacturing. Wilson Sporting Goods is a named customer for the EvoShield brand, while the company’s membership in the Carolina Textile District and Manufactured in North Carolina reflects its integration into the regional textile supply chain.

Parker Medical emphasizes ethical manufacturing, stating that none of its products contain substances listed under the EU REACH regulation or California Proposition 65. Its mission highlights quality, responsiveness, corporate citizenship, a safe workplace, and long‑term partnerships built on clear implementation plans from design through delivery.
